slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: signals a luxury Greek island wedding while the guide covers six regions.
slots.shot_brief: Official image from one venue confirmed in this guide (planner-sme list), ideally the first region covered: ceremony terrace or aisle set above the Aegean, whitewashed architecture and open sea or caldera in one frame, June to September, sunset or golden-hour light. No people, or only distant unidentifiable figures; no other hotels' signage. Landscape 3:2 with room for a title crop. Location proven by the venue's own media kit or a register row, never by appearance. Source: the venue's own media kit or press office with written permission, or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to the register. Never AI, never a competitor, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image.
